Le champignon Pouce-de-Lune, parfois désigné comme Ver Luisant, restaure immédiatement 1 à 10 points de vie après ingestion. Il conserve ses vertus lorsqu'il est séché, qualité utile pour un produit provenant de milieux souterrains où sa récolte reste exceptionnellement difficile.

This fungus is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in underground environments, and is best known in north-eastern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

Moonthumb fungus, sometimes known as Glow Worm, immediately restores 1–10 concussion hits when eaten. It retains its potency after drying, a valuable property for a product of underground environments where gathering it is exceptionally difficult.
